question.text: In India, the Personal Laws governing inheritance for Muslims follow:

explanation.text: The Logic: Inheritance of Muslims in India is governed by Mohammedan Personal laws, as referenced in the workbook. The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937 is the statutory framework under which these personal laws apply. The Trap: The Hindu Succession Act, 1956 applies to Hindus, and the Indian Succession Act, 1925 applies to Christians and Parsis; neither governs Muslim inheritance. Note: The workbook page refers to Mohammedan Personal laws governing inheritance of Muslims, without invoking any Uniform Civil Code wording.
